stem:
Meena keeps four steel bottles of water in different places in her house. She measures the temperature of the water in each bottle with a thermometer.

Bottle A is at 25 °C, Bottle B is at 40 °C, Bottle C is at 18 °C, and Bottle D is at 32 °C.

Which bottle has the coldest water?

teacher.key_rationale: A colder body has a lower temperature. The lowest reading is 18 °C for Bottle C, so Bottle C has the coldest water. Options A and D tempt students who misjudge mid-range values, and B tempts students who reverse the relationship and pick the highest temperature.
